body:
The night started with wanting to enjoy a nice night with some MDA and Cannabis which I smoke with every drug I do. Anyways.. I will give a timeline and exactly what went on in my head and around it =)
9:15PM -- I weigh out 250mg of MDA crystals and put it in a small glass of orange juice and drink it up.
9:25PM -- Smoke a couple of bowls of cannabis to relax my mind.
10:03PM -- I definitely feel the MDA kicking in, I feel a really nice body high coming on and my eyes are starting to get twitch, jaw is getting tighter. Smoke a couple more bowls of cannabis. Sit back and hear some music, on my LAzy Boy
10:30PM -- The MDA is in full effect now my pupils are extremely dilated to the point where all you see is my pupils. I'm getting hallucinations almost like the beginning of a shroom trip, the body high is great, feeling awesome!
10:50PM -- As the MDA continues to peak I decided to weight out another 250mg of MDA and mix with some orange juice and drink it up. I also smoke a couple more bowls of Cannabis. Everything felt amazing... I had no negative thoughts just complete Joy.
11:45PM -- The 2nd dose of MDA is hitting now and wow... This is amazing.... The body high is unexplainable I feel just pure ECSTASY! Its the only word to describe it. The visual hallucinations are alot more noticeable, it's almost like a mushroom trip. I decide to go outside and walk around and smoke a couple of cigarettes and just enjoy the outdoors since I live near a wooded area. All the sounds are extremely loud and crisp I can hear every little bugs making noises, the wind blowing the the trees, the steps I'm making its like I can hear it and feel everything at the same time! The sky was full of stars and I sat there just watching the stars feeling incredible.
1:38AM -- After spending quite some time outdoors I head back inside to smoke some more cannabis. I feel that with every psychedelic drug cannabis is a perfect match except LSD where the drug is so strong it overpowers the Cannabis. I smoke a bit and sit back in my chair and put on Pink Floyd: The Dark Side of the moon and just close my eyes. I can see like kaleidoscope images with with almost like amazing colors.... I didn't want to open my eyes.
2:30AM -- The MDA is still peaking great... I decide to call my girlfriend and we talked for about an hour, topics ranging from what we were put on this earth to do, the happiness that having a good relationship brings us and I was really able to open up and tell her things about my past that I didn't want to tell her, but it all worked out great.
3:36AM -- I can feel the MDA is slowly starting to wear off, the visuals are not as strong and the eye twitching is almost gone. I still feel a very good body high though. I smoke a little more cannabis and it helps boost up the MDA effects. I decide to write some lyrics for some songs I'm working on. So I spend the next hour or so doing that.
4:45AM -- The MDA is pretty much worn off I'm feeling the comedown effects coming on. So I take 4mg of Xanax and 30mg of Hydrocodone, a multivitamin and wash it down with a freshly made Lemonade.
5:15AM -- I can feel the Xanax kicking in, I feel very relaxed, no worries, no negative thoughts just pure bliss.... Right now I'm just reclining back in my Lazy Boy hearing some psy-chillout music.
5:30AM -- The Hydrocodone is taking effect now as I'm feeling my body completely relax the jaw tension is relieved, and I have to say that this is the best trip I have had on MDA...
The Xanax and Hydrocodone helped amazingly with the comedown I actually felt no negative effects, just PURE EUPHORIC BLISS
